entries.title: Psalms 59:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician; set to Al-tashheth. A Psalm of David. Michtam; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.>> Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: Set me on high from them that rise up against me.

entries.title: Psalms 59:2
segments: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, And save me from the bloodthirsty men.

entries.title: Psalms 59:3
segments: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul; The mighty gather themselves together against me: Not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 59:4
segments: They run and prepare themselves without [my] fault: Awake thou to help me, and behold.

entries.title: Psalms 59:5
segments: Even thou, O Jehovah God of hosts, the God of Israel, Arise to visit all the nations: Be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 59:6
segments: They return at evening, they howl like a dog, And go round about the city.

entries.title: Psalms 59:7
segments: Behold, they belch out with their mouth; Swords are in their lips: For who, [say they], doth hear?

entries.title: Psalms 59:8
segments: But thou, O Jehovah, wilt laugh at them; Thou wilt have all the nations in derision.

entries.title: Psalms 59:9
segments: [Because of] his strength I will give heed unto thee; For God is my high tower.

entries.title: Psalms 59:10
segments: My God with his lovingkindness will meet me: God will let me see [my desire] upon mine enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 59:11
segments: Slay them not, lest my people forget: Scatter them by thy power, and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

entries.title: Psalms 59:12
segments: [For] the sin of their mouth, [and] the words of their lips, Let them even be taken in their pride, And for cursing and lying which they speak.

entries.title: Psalms 59:13
segments: Consume them in wrath, consume them, so that they shall be no more: And let them know that God ruleth in Jacob, Unto the ends of the earth.  Selah

entries.title: Psalms 59:14
segments: And at evening let them return, let them howl like a dog, And go round about the city.

entries.title: Psalms 59:15
segments: They shall wander up and down for food, And tarry all night if they be not satisfied.

entries.title: Psalms 59:16
segments: But I will sing of thy strength; Yea, I will sing aloud of thy lovingkindness in the morning: For thou hast been my high tower, And a refuge in the day of my distress.

entries.title: Psalms 59:17
segments: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing praises: For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
